Note 2: Due to the bugs, the press has been removed from the Atom Shop for the time being.

Note Bug: The fake bottle cap press generates oil and aluminum instead of lead and aluminum. In addition, the press uses the camp maximum of the firewood stack, so you can only build one or the other.

Bug: Counterfeit Bottlepress Machine generates Oil and Aluminum (instead of Lead) and it uses the camp max counter of the firewood pile

Due to the bugs, the counterfeit bottle press machine was removed from the atomic shop.
